summary: Never tell a worker to edit a policy file owned by another shard (e.g. a fast_check allowlist entry from the cashier shard). Ask it to report the needed policy change; the owning shard commits it, with a test. The trusted scanner also had to apply its allowlist to direct import-binding patches, not only dynamic ones.
